chunks: Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Ali, from Abi Ibrahim عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the deceased who dies while in a state of janabah. He said: “One ghusl.”

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: If a deceased person dies while in a state of janabah, is one ghusl sufficient?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who dies while in a state of janabah. The Imam عليه السلام states that a single ghusl suffices, indicating no separate additional ghusl is required for janabah apart from the prescribed washing of the deceased.
